description: This file implements an HTTP client with security features such as IP range checks, hostname validation, and proxy configuration for the Mattermost server. It includes functions for IP address validation, network interface inspection, and custom transport creation with security filters.

methods.name: IsReservedIP
methods.description: Checks if an IP address belongs to a reserved IP range to prevent SSRF attacks.

methods.name: IsOwnIP
methods.description: Determines if a given IP address matches any of the host's network interface IPs.

methods.name: dialContextFilter
methods.description: Wraps a dial function to enforce host and IP allowlist policies, providing detailed error messages.

methods.name: getProxyFn
methods.description: Returns a function to determine proxy URL from environment, with IPv6 URL validation.

methods.name: NewTransport
methods.description: Creates a custom HTTP transport with security filters, proxy support, and configurable TLS verification.
